theme: 3 terms on loading states: the spinner, the pull gesture, and the control that starts a refresh

terms.definition: A small spinning wheel that shows the app is busy.
terms.example: Show an Activity Indicator while the notes load.

terms.definition: A gesture where the user drags a list down to load fresh data.
terms.example: Pull to Refresh is the usual way to reload a feed.

terms.definition: A built-in control that you attach to a table to start a refresh and show a spinner.
terms.example: Attach a Refresh Control to the table, then call `endRefreshing` when the data arrives.

video.title: Activity Indicator, Pull to Refresh & Refresh Control | Day 110
video.description:
Learn to explain how to show loading and refreshing in a list: Activity Indicator, Pull to Refresh & Refresh Control, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Activity Indicator - A small spinning wheel that shows the app is busy.
Pull to Refresh - A gesture where the user drags a list down to load fresh data.
Refresh Control - A built-in control that you attach to a table to start a refresh and show a spinner.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Activity Indicator, Pull to Refresh & Refresh Control | Day 110
landscape.description:
Explain Activity Indicator, Pull to Refresh & Refresh Control in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
액티비티 인디케이터, 당겨서 새로고침, 리프레시 컨트롤 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Activity Indicator - A small spinning wheel that shows the app is busy.
한국어: 액티비티 인디케이터: 앱이 작업 중임을 보여 주는 작은 회전 바퀴

Pull to Refresh - A gesture where the user drags a list down to load fresh data.
한국어: 당겨서 새로고침: 사용자가 목록을 아래로 당겨 새 데이터를 불러오는 제스처

Refresh Control - A built-in control that you attach to a table to start a refresh and show a spinner.
한국어: 리프레시 컨트롤: 테이블에 붙여 새로고침을 시작하고 스피너를 보여 주는 기본 컨트롤

In this video, Mina and Jake decide how a notes list shows loading and refreshing, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Spinner or Pull to Refresh? Can you explain the difference in English?

dialogue.title: Loading or refreshing?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the first load shows a blank list for a few seconds.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add an Activity Indicator while the notes load.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And later refreshes? Users should pull down.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's Pull to Refresh. Attach a Refresh Control to the table.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I did, like in the code. It calls `loadNotes` on `valueChanged`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Does the Refresh Control show its own spinner?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, it has a built-in one. So no extra Activity Indicator.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Use the Activity Indicator only for the first load.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When does the Refresh Control stop?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When you call `endRefreshing`. It's in your closure, good.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect. Pull to Refresh feels natural now.
